understanding still has 2 undigested unknowns: How many of the 102 commands genuinely conflict on a resource. The achievable speedup is bounded by that count and is not known until the claims are declared.; Whether any validate command silently depends on running after an earlier one, an ordering coupling the sequential loop has been hiding.
